definitions.explanation: A flat elevated area of land at high altitude.

examples.japanese: {高原|こうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{澄|す}んでいる→澄む：13370_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The air in the highlands is clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高原|こうげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spend summer in the highlands.

examples.japanese: {高原|こうげん}⟦リゾート→リゾート：11394_rizooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to a highland resort.

notes:
{高原|こうげん} refers to a plateau or highland - a flat elevated area of land at high altitude.

WRITING:
⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + {原|げん} (plain, field) = high plain/plateau

FAMOUS JAPANESE HIGHLANDS:
- ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧{高原|こうげん}: Karuizawa plateau (Nagano)
- ⟦{阿蘇|あそ}→阿蘇：noentry⟧{高原|こうげん}: Aso highlands (Kumamoto)
- ⟦{八ヶ岳|やつがたけ}→八ヶ岳：noentry⟧{高原|こうげん}: Yatsugatake highlands
- ⟦{那須|なす}→那須：noentry⟧{高原|こうげん}: Nasu highlands

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高原|こうげん}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: highland vegetables (cooler climate produce)
- {高原|こうげん}⟦リゾート→リゾート：11394_rizooto⟧: highland resort
- {高原|こうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: highland air
- {高原|こうげん}⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧: highland pasture/ranch

GEOGRAPHY TERMS:
- ⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧: plain (lowland)
- ⟦{盆地|ぼんち}→盆地：00015_bonchi⟧: basin
- ⟦{山地|さんち}→山地：12647_sanchi⟧: mountainous area
